headline: Frequent Rework on App Class Resizing Logic
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring focus on resizing logic and related documentation, suggesting ongoing issues with the implementation. The high number of fix/revert commits (179) indicates instability, particularly around screen resizing and breakpoint handling.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the resizing logic implemented in the App class, focusing on the methods related to screen size adjustments and breakpoints.
Identify and document the specific conditions under which resizing fails or behaves unexpectedly, as indicated by the commit messages such as 'Fix size error' and 'faster breakpoints'.
Implement unit tests targeting the resizing functionality to ensure that changes do not introduce new issues, especially in relation to dependent files.
Establish a clear ownership structure for the resizing logic, assigning a specific team member to maintain and oversee changes to this critical functionality.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated engineer to oversee resizing logic to reduce bus factor.
